notes: «فأخبرنا أن زيد بن ثابت أخبره» follows the scene «أنه رأى مروان بن الحكم»: whoever informed them after the scene is not named, and Marwan is only in the scene (rule 6), so he is not added.
Zayd is the Companion whose account of the Prophet's dictation is the saying; the gap between Sahl and Zayd is unresolved.
